item.title: The strange ordinariness of high-frequency signal preservation in the stratigraphic record
item.description: The stratigraphic record is famously fragmentary, but it is also full of short, relatively complete fragments — laminated siltstones, eolian cross sets, point bars — that record ordinary events at seasonal to annual resolution.
